caption: The four dates in order, with the gap in years written on each arrow: Unix 1969, C rewrite 1973, Linux kernel 1991, Linux 1.0 1994. First to last is 25 years, and 18 of those years sit between the C rewrite and the Linux kernel.

spec.title: Four dates, three gaps
spec.aria: A left-to-right chain of four dated milestones, Unix in 1969, the C rewrite in 1973, the Linux kernel in 1991 and Linux 1.0 in 1994, with gaps of 4, 18 and 3 years marked on the arrows between them.
